title: Temporary Ban
body:
# BetterTempBan
**BetterTempBan** is a lightweight Paper plugin that gives server administrators clean, flexible temporary ban management. Ban any player — online or offline — with a simple command, a custom reason, and a time duration. Banned players are greeted with a detailed disconnect screen showing who banned them, when, and how long they have left.

The ban is UUID-based on online servers so name changes never bypass a ban. Running a cracked server? Flip one config option and it switches to username-based tracking automatically.

---

## Features

- `/tempban <player> <time> <reason>` — Ban any player, online or offline
- `/tempunban <player>` — Unban from in-game or console
- `/tempbanlist` — View all active bans with banner, reason and time remaining
- `/baninfo <player>` — View a player's active ban, UUID, IP, and full ban history
- Supports `s`, `m`, `h`, `d` time units (e.g. `30m`, `12h`, `7d`)
- Custom disconnect screen showing ban date, banner, reason and time remaining
- Cracked server mode which switches to username-based tracking with one config toggle
- IP banning which blocks ban evasion via alt accounts
- Full ban history logged to `banlog.yml` including unbans and expiries
- Bans persist across restarts via `bans.yml`
- Expired bans logged to console automatically

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/tempban <player> <time> <reason>` | Temporarily ban a player | `bettertempban.ban` |
| `/tempunban <player>` | Remove a temporary ban | `bettertempban.unban` |
| `/tempbanlist` | List all active temp bans | `bettertempban.list` |
| `/baninfo <player>` | View ban info and history | `bettertempban.info` |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `bettertempban.ban` | Access to `/tempban` | OP |
| `bettertempban.unban` | Access to `/tempunban` | OP |
| `bettertempban.list` | Access to `/tempbanlist` | OP |
| `bettertempban.info` | Access to `/baninfo` | OP |
| `bettertempban.bypass` | Bypass temp bans entirely | `false` |

---

## Configuration

```yaml
cracked-server: false
ban-ip: true
```
